finding.text: Requirement 2 and 3 are proved for one page only. proof.md has a crumb/href table for `tabs-page` (3 urls) but not for the other eight demo pages, and no `.live-page` / gear / no-Files-button row per url at 400 and 1200. The ask was "one table row per url".

Requirement 6 "before and after" is not met. There are no shots of `/live/design/` or `/live/lab/is-page/`, and no "before" shot of anything; proof.md says `/live/` "DIFFs" and explains it away instead of showing the before/after.

The retitles put a sentence into the title, which is also the h1 and the tab label (live readme line 88, "one title everywhere"). On columns-page at 400 the h1 reads "Columns (shows as plain t…" (shots/…columns/sheet.png, left frame; layout.json widest_text 444, 454 on place, 496 on place-fresh, all wider than the 400 viewport). Per-demo gaps belong in the page body or `page-features.md`, not in the title. Layout 3 / Words 2.

Requirement 4: columns, nav and place draw "Nothing on screen yet." (shots/…columns/sheet.png, band live-main ink 0.12-0.24) while their titles say they work "as plain tabs". The "log one line naming what LivePage lacks" is in session.jsonl and `page-features.md`, but the pages themselves show nothing a visitor can learn from. Minimum fix: a one-line `part-text` on each saying what it would demonstrate and what LivePage lacks.

`tabs-page/page.jsonl` keeps dead lines (`class` = Page.class.js, `navigation:"tabs"`, five `{"tab":…}` lines, a `hello-michael` content line tagged `tab:"overview"`) plus a new `{"file":"ai/","gone":true}`. The doc admits they are dead but the data is left to mislead the next editor; `jsonl.md` says "no Files button at all", while this line is how it was hidden, so that claim is not shown to be true by the code.

Indexing / staleness: `public/live/readme.md:42` still describes page-features as "which ones actually draw, and why"; there is no demos readme, so the nine `demos/*` pages and their state are indexed only by the table in `doc/page-features.md`. `proof.md` "Open" section says tabs become opt-in (`{"tab":true}`) once live-r8 lands, but nothing outside proof.md records that follow-up (no task or note on the session), so a fresh agent opening only this folder would miss it. `proof.md` lists "plus two more compliance/dev merges" without hashes. Add the follow-up as a task on the session.
Page structure: every shot has the same four bands; at 3440 `tabs-page/alpha` is 71% empty (layout.json), a width cap in LivePage, not this diff.
`place-fresh`, `place-page` and `place` are now three near-identical retitled pages (Requirement 4 "no second version"); consider merging them.
